review.notes: Inspected all after-page renderings, extracted candidate text, PDF metadata/annotations, plan.json, and pages.json. Page 1 redactions remove the byline, affiliations, author footnote, arXiv side label, and project URL; candidate text and raw strings no longer contain the planned forbidden identifiers. Pixel comparison shows pages 2-23 are unchanged from before, and all page 1 visual differences are confined to planned redaction rectangles with no clipping of surrounding scientific text or figures. Ordinary references and scientific content are preserved.
